rebuild: cd shared/marks-v2 && node tools/build.mjs && node tools/emit.mjs (headless Chrome; writes out/, tools/measure.json, ../marks.js, ../../c-daylight-atlas/marks.js, sources.json)
rules: Official artwork only. No recolouring, redrawing or geometry changes. SVG edits are limited to dropping the XML prolog and editor comments, setting the root viewBox/width/height (the crop), and, for lockups, dropping wordmark elements that lie wholly outside the crop (each verified pixel-identical). Optical scale is metadata only.
opticalScaleMethod: inkBox = alpha-weighted share of a square box covered by the mark when contained in it (measured at 512px). scale = (min inkBox / inkBox) ^ 0.25, rounded to 0.01; render at box * scale. Platform glyphs are normalised among themselves.
